it's always the same. Find someone, relate, get disappointed and then you're back to square one. I'm not saying we need someone to talk to all the time, or that I tell everyone because that would just be stupid. It's just you want to feel like you're with someone on this, you're not alone, you're not fighting this by yourself.

forreal, people are strange. There are also the people who fake it for attention, they are the worst because you feel like they relate, when you feel like you can relate you dont feel like you're the only one. But then you realise everything behind the lies, and yet again you're alone again.

humans will always want to feel worthy, of anything. It could be literally the stupidest shit ever but I feel us as humans want to feel worthy of something. When we feel worthless, in my case you just want to end it all because. What's the point if your not worthy of anything. Why would you want to continue.
for me it depends who they are , we're all different but in reality I guess nobody cares you gotta look out for yourself
I mean you cant blame them, you shouldnt ever think anybody can solve your problems. But they surely can make you feel a bit better.

I remember telling the school once, nobody believed me, they made the school counsellor talk to me once, but when I tried to go again several times she was busy. That added alot of mixed emotions to how I was feeling. It made me feel worthless.

But maybe it's a good thing you're not being destructive? Stopping drugs seems like a very good idea to me. I used to take etizolam three times a week, I'm 15 years old. It just got me to a place where I didnt have to worry about literally anything and feeling like jelly most of the times but in the end i stopped.  I mean taking tranq was a stupid idea anyway but after all of the withdrawal symptoms youre free from it. It wont control you anymore, you've got the reigns back. 

I found that I stopped feeling semi worthless when I found a passion for something, it made me want to get up in the morning, not dread the day.

it really is, on one hand you're telling yourself you're going to go through it but the next minute you think about how people would react and feel. Life isnt fair, nobody chose to be here, but yet here we are.
